candidates.review_note: Build each inter-station motion from acceleration, constant-speed travel, and symmetric deceleration; its duration is distance/speed + speed/acceleration. Include the specified dwell time only between legs. First check overlapping station dwell intervals from both directions to identify station meetings and their earliest time. Otherwise their summed traveled distance is continuous and monotone, so high-precision bisection finds the unique first meeting within the total journey time. Evaluate piecewise physical displacement, convert feet back to miles, and round only the final displayed values. Parsing decimals exactly avoids binary half-rounding artifacts.
